Based on my comprehensive search of the repository, I cannot find any per-user API rate-limiting middleware registered in this codebase. 

The middleware registration in `server/server.go` (lines 51-52) only includes:
- `middleware.Recover()` - for panic recovery
- `newCORSMiddleware(profile)` - for CORS handling

The Connect interceptors in `server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go` include:
- MetadataInterceptor (header conversion)
- LoggingInterceptor (request logging)
- RecoveryInterceptor (panic handling)
- AuthInterceptor (authentication)

But none of these implement rate limiting.

The only request-level limit found is `maxAPIRequestBytes = 256 << 20` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` (line 20), which is a maximum request size limit, not a per-user rate-limiting limit.

**Correction**: There is no per-user API rate-limiting middleware registered in this repository. The premise appears to be incorrect.
